description: This PHP source file defines a class 'Upload' within the 'Opencart\Admin\Model\Tool' namespace, providing methods to manage file upload records in an Opencart-based system's database, including adding, deleting, retrieving uploads, and filtering them based on various criteria.

classes.name: Upload
classes.description: A model class providing CRUD operations and filters for managing upload records in the database.

methods.name: addUpload
methods.description: Creates a new upload record in the database with a generated token code.

methods.name: deleteUpload
methods.description: Removes an upload record identified by its upload ID.

methods.name: getUpload
methods.description: Retrieves an upload record by its upload ID.

methods.name: getUploadByCode
methods.description: Retrieves an upload record by its unique code.

methods.name: getUploads
methods.description: Fetches multiple upload records based on filter criteria, with sorting and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalUploads
methods.description: Returns the total count of upload records matching filter criteria.
